description: This file is a shell script used for managing the static WAN connection, including bringing the WAN interface up or down based on system events and link states. It sets system parameters, updates sysevent values, and controls firewall and routing configurations.

methods.name: bring_wan_down
methods.description: Disables IPv4 forwarding, resets WAN IP and subnet, restarts firewall, and updates system state to indicate WAN is down.

methods.name: bring_wan_up
methods.description: Configures WAN interface parameters, enables IPv4 forwarding, restarts firewall, and updates system state to indicate WAN is up, also triggers time synchronization if enabled.
